baseline.workflow: inject 503 for Access Refresh after a successful roster load
baseline.observed: control recovered, no durable visible failure, unhandled page error

covered: retained last-known data and independent region failure
poll retry, deduplication, recovery, and last-success timestamp
intentional abort, timeout, offline hint, and current-session 401
H01 account isolation, H02 response ownership, and H03 polling lifecycle
bounded diagnostics without response bodies or secrets

limitations: Browser offline state is a connectivity hint rather than proof of service reachability.
Safari, Firefox, physical-device, and specialist screen-reader testing were not performed.
